Ari Mendes: Hi everyone Im Ari, starting today on Eng Runtime. Excited to meet you all! Quick onboarding q: who handles laptop provisioning and VPN group access?
Samir: Welcome Ari! For laptop/MDM the help-it team + Maya can help. For VPN and infra perms, ping Eliot.
Maya: @Ari welcome! Ill send the MDM invite to your email. Check spam if you dont see it in 10m. If the installer asks for a cert, let me know.
Eliot: @Ari drop your seat email here and Ill add you to infra-remote and the prod-read groups. Ill also schedule the Okta push.
Ari Mendes: ari.mendes@redwood.com thanks! Also curious about mentor pairing for the first week any volunteers?
Noor: Happy to mentor for the week Tue/Thu pairing windows work best for me. I can do a runtime test walkthrough and CI setup.
Zoe Liu: Welcome Ari! Quick non-technical Q: which sticker pack should we send? Options: ramen, tiny-gpu, puffer. Pro ramen judge bonus points. :ramen:
Ari Mendes: Ramen and tiny-gpu please :) Fun fact: Im a weekend ramen competition judge.
Samir: Love that. Well mention your ramen expertise in the standup intro. Also FYI the onboarding checklist is pinned in #devex/onboarding.
Devex Bot:
```
/onboard checklist show Ari Mendes
/help-it submit_ticket --type=workstation --priority=normal
```
Maya: MDM invite sent. Eliot: did infra invites go out?
Eliot: Sent Okta invite and VPN client instructions. You should be in the infra groups now try connecting and tell me if the route to vpc.redwood.internal fails.
Ari Mendes: Got the Okta email and MDM enroll link. Trying VPN now. Thanks everyone!
Samir: Nice well do a five-minute intros at eng runtime standup in 25m no pressure. Welcome again :tada:
